Kasen X2.0 Electric Bike - 750W BAFANG Motor, 48V Samsung Battery, 28 MPH, 55-Mile Range, Hydraulic Brakes, 7-Speed Shimano Gears

Kasen X2.0 Electric Bike – Power, Performance, and Precision

Why Choose the Kasen X2.0?

The Kasen X2.0 combines power, performance, and practicality in one sleek package. The Kasen X2.0 is the ultimate electric bike for urban commuters and adventure seekers. Whether you're commuting to work, exploring trails, or running errands, this e-bike is designed to meet your needs.

Built with a 750W BAFANG rear hub motor, a 48V 15AH Samsung lithium-ion long-range battery, this e-bike delivers unmatched performance with speeds of up to 28 MPH and a range of 45-55 miles on a single charge. With all the premium components, the Kasen X2.0 is the perfect choice for riders who demand the best.

Whether you're cruising through city streets or tackling rugged terrains, the Kasen X2.0 is designed to keep you moving with style and efficiency.

Available in black, light blue, and red, the Kasen X2.0 is as stylish as it is functional. Upgrade your ride today and experience the future of electric biking!

Key Features:

Performance That Excites:

Speed: Reach up to 28 MPH with pedal assist and 25 MPH with the thumb throttle.

Range: Travel 35-45 miles on a single charge, perfect for long commutes or weekend adventures.

Charge Time: Fully recharge in just 4-7 hours with the included 48V 3.0 Amp Smart Charger.

Weight & Capacity: Weighing only 80 lbs, the Kasen X2.0 supports a maximum payload of 330 lbs, making it ideal for riders of all sizes.

Cutting-Edge Tech Specs:

Motor: 750W BAFANG rear hub motor for powerful acceleration and hill-climbing capability.

Battery: Removable 48V 15AH (840WH) Samsung lithium-ion battery for long-lasting performance.

Display: Digiwise BC300 Colored Backlit Display for easy monitoring of speed, battery life, and pedal assist levels.

Pedal Assist: 5-level intelligent pedal assist with torque sensor for a smooth and responsive ride.

Lights: High-output LED headlight with a red LED tail light with brake indicator for enhanced safety.

Premium Components for Durability & Comfort:

Frame: Lightweight yet durable 6061 double-butted aluminum alloy frame with an integrated battery design.

Suspension: Ari suspension fork with 110mm travel and preload adjustment for a smooth ride on any terrain.

Brakes: Reliable Tektro 180mm hydraulic disc brakes for superior stopping power in all conditions.

Gears: Shimano 7-speed shifter and 14T-28T cassette for precise control and effortless shifting.

Tires: Kenda 20x4.0 fat tires for excellent traction and stability on both paved and off-road surfaces.

Comfort: Ergonomic grips, a Kasen saddle, and Wellgo aluminum alloy pedals ensure a comfortable ride every time.

Practical Add-Ons:

Rear Rack: Supports up to 55 lbs for carrying cargo or accessories.

Fenders: Full-coverage front and rear fenders to keep you clean and dry in wet conditions.

Differences between X2.0 & X1.0

The X2.0 upgrades the pedal assist system to a torque sensor vs. cadence sensor in X1.0. The X2.0 features an Ari suspension fork with slightly more travel (110mm) vs. (100mm) in X1.0.

Pedal Assist Sensor:

X2.0: Torque sensor for a smoother and more responsive ride.

X1.0: 24-magnet cadence sensor.

Suspension Fork:

X2.0: Ari suspension fork with 110mm travel and preload adjustment.

X1.0: Hydraulic fork with 100mm travel, lockout, and preload adjustment.

Rear Suspension:
X2.0: Pneumatic fully adjustable with lock out features.
X1.0: Rear suspension: Coil over shock, semi-adjustable

Available Colors:

X2.0: Black, light blue, red.

X1.0: Black, blue, white.

Kasen X2.0 Suspension Fork

Type: Ari suspension fork with 110mm travel.

Features: Preload adjustment (no lockout).

Rear suspension: Pneumatic fully adjustable with lock out features.

Strengths:

110mm Travel:

Offers more suspension travel than the X1.0, making it better suited for rougher terrain and more aggressive riding.

Provides greater shock absorption for off-road trails, bumpy surfaces, and technical terrain.

Preload Adjustment:

Like the X1.0, it allows riders to adjust the suspension stiffness to match their weight and riding style.

Ensures a comfortable ride on uneven surfaces.

No Lockout:

While this means the fork is always active (less efficient on smooth surfaces), it ensures consistent performance on rough terrain.

Best For:

Off-road riding (e.g., mountain trails, rocky paths, or uneven terrain).

Adventure riding on mixed surfaces with a focus on comfort and stability.

Riders who prioritize shock absorption and trail performance over efficiency on smooth roads.

Kasen X2.0 Fork is better for:

Riders who frequently tackle rough terrain, off-road trails, or technical surfaces.

Those who prioritize comfort and shock absorption over efficiency on smooth roads.

Choose the X2.0 fork if you’re an adventure rider or off-road enthusiast who needs more suspension travel for rough terrain.

Kasen X1.0 Fork is better for:

Riders who primarily ride on paved roads, light trails, or mixed surfaces. Those who value efficiency and the ability to lock out the suspension for climbing or smooth riding.

Choose the X1.0 fork if you’re a commuter or casual rider who occasionally ventures onto light trails.
